newsitem.title: INDIA: India metals mixed, rates unchanged by state firms.
newsitem.headline: India metals mixed, rates unchanged by state firms.

text.p: Indian metals' prices were mixed on Monday as state agencies maintained old prices for their products, dealers said. Tin and nickel fell on fresh arrivals.
Ready tin slid by 100 rupees to 34,200 rupees while nickel fell by 100 rupees to 36,700 rupees. Last week nickel was down by 300 rupees and tin was down by 800 rupees.
Copper was steady at the reduced level of 12,300 rupees. Zinc was unchanged at 6,450 rupees and lead at 4,450 rupees.
Dealers said Hindustan Copper and Hindustan Zinc did not change selling prices of copper, zinc and lead for the second half of this month. Aluminium was steady at 7,300 rupees.
